outcomes.intended_user_result: When recall is item-budgeted, stronger lexical matches appear before weaker matches without leaking scope or provenance.
outcomes.current_baseline: Lexical score is computed for each match but results follow database recency order, so a newer low-score match can consume the item budget before an older higher-score match.
outcomes.acceptance: For equivalent authorized data, hits sort by descending lexical score, ties remain deterministic by existing recency order and record identity, and scope, provenance, coverage, and budgets remain unchanged.

excluded_scope: No vector, model, graph, MCP, connector, or external backend.
No preference, fading, dream-policy, schema, or database migration changes.
No change to scope authorization, provenance, or live data.
No remote publication without new explicit authorization for R-0002.

allowed_actions: create GitHub release with verified artifact
